page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc6.10xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz. The hardware configuration delivers 40 physical cores and 40 vCPUs, operating with a single thread per core. It is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.4 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps. Virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark evaluations place the ecs.hfc6.10xlarge in the average performance tier across multiple metrics. In compute-focused tests, the instance achieved a stress-ng single-core score of 1439.29 and a multi-core score of 38381.56, alongside a Passmark CPU score of 34144.54. Memory subsystem performance shows a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 2132.58 GB/sec, which drops to 105.52 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, and a write bandwidth of 36.66 GB/sec. For specialized workloads, the server demonstrated a static web serving throughput of 23.2 GB/sec and processed Redis SET operations at 34.66 million operations per second. Small-scale LLM inference tests using a 135M model yielded 1928.13 tokens per second for prompt processing and 76.69 tokens per second for text generation, while a 7B model achieved 57.07 tokens per second and 12.33 tokens per second respectively.

The instance offers a high-frequency CPU profile with dedicated core allocation, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for compute-bound tasks that do not require massive memory footprints. However, the lack of bundled local storage and GPU hardware represents a clear tradeoff, restricting its utility for massive dataset processing or heavy deep learning training. The 2.4 GB per core memory ratio is relatively lean, positioning this server primarily for high-compute workloads such as multi-threaded compilation, web serving, database operations, and moderate-scale text or image processing.
